items.name: Reincarnated as Slime Mug
items.summary: 'That Time I Was Reincarnated as a Slime' anime mug with unicorn symbol.

Purchased because narrator liked it and felt it accurately reflects recent experiences - has been perceived as a 'slime' (low-value, simple) but is actually very capable and intelligent. Also references narrator's history of resetting and learning - multiple reinventions leading to greater capability each time.
items.significance: Symbol of transformation/rebirth. Unicorn = large amount of money (billion dollar company). Also represents: perceived as slime but actually capable/intelligent, history of resetting and learning, PWN = owned/controlled or chess pawn becoming anything. Left as intentional multi-interpretation message.

perspectives.author: matt
perspectives.interpretation: Cleaning/scrubbing and preparing to run. Rebirth into new identity/life.
